I am an economist whose research sits at the intersection of **environmental, urban,
and real estate economics**. My work examines how cities adapt to environmental
pressures and policy — including land use and zoning, sustainability in urban
settings, and the social and economic dimensions of community-engaged scholarship.

## Research interests

- Environmental and urban economics
- Real estate, land use, and zoning
- Sustainability in an urban context
- Community-engaged and community-integrated research
